title: Make Rich Text, type, ⌘B on a selected word, and ⌘S saves RTF with that word bold
note: TE-03: the rich-text editor applies Format ▸ Font ▸ Bold (⌘B) to the selection and a new rich document saves as TextEdit-compatible RTF; the expected file is the exact bytes rmac_editor::rich::rtf::write produces.
